intro: At BMSR, we believe in smooth sailing, both at sea and in service. Behind every successful voyage is a passionate, hard-working crew, and we're proud to introduce the people who keep our ship steady and our standards high.

teams.name: Leadership
teams.intro: The leadership team are Chairman The Honourable George Nelson McDonald Fergusson, OR, Director Simon, Director Kent and Company Secretary Amanda, with day-to-day operations led by Chief Executive Officer and Principal Registrar Giovanni Ciniglio, with a clear vision dedicated to steering Barbados Maritime towards continued growth and excellence, supported by the BMSR team with integrity and dedication.

teams.name: Operations
teams.intro: Say hello to Makis and Captain Jithesh, our operations dream team. Whether it's managing logistics or navigating the seas, they keep everything shipshape with precision and a smile.

teams.name: Registry
teams.intro: Vidhi, Andrea, Charlotte and Marion are the friendly faces behind our Registry team. Organised, dedicated and always ready to help, you can count on them to keep things running seamlessly.

teams.name: STCW
teams.intro: Meet Elvis and Jay, our training and certification pros. They're the go-to people for all things STCW, making sure seafarers are qualified, confident and ready to sail.

teams.name: Office
teams.intro: The heart of our headquarters beats strong with our Office Manager Gedd, who brings a sense of calm, order and humour to the daily flow of office life.

people.name: The Honourable George Nelson McDonald Fergusson, OR

crew: And of course, behind every great team is… the whole team!

From Chairman The Honourable George Nelson McDonald Fergusson, OR, Kent, Simon and Amanda to Giovanni, Makis, Captain Jithesh, Vidhi, Andrea, Charlotte, Marion, Elvis, Jay and Gedd, each one plays a vital role in making Barbados Maritime what it is today: trusted, professional and always ready to go the extra nautical mile.
Along with our BMSR Regional Registrars, ANI inspectors, Barbadian shipowners, managers, seafarers, suppliers and supporters.
